claims.content: The Auctioneer wants to analyze inventory availability and aging by reviewing the Inventory Performance & Aging Report's summary counts for auction-available items and extended costs.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Auctioneer wants to analyze inventory availability and aging by reviewing the Inventory Performance & Aging Report's summary counts for auction-available items and extended costs.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Auctioneer reviews the Inventory Performance & Aging Report and sees summary counts for auction-available items and extended costs, as well as key inventory data by cost, units, and unique SKUs for auction-available inventory categories and total auction-available inventory.
scope_contract.start_boundary: Beginning when the Auctioneer seeks to analyze inventory availability and aging via inventory performance and aging summaries.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Auctioneer has analyzed inventory availability and aging using the report's summary counts for auction-available items and extended costs and its key inventory data by cost, units, and unique SKUs.
in_scope_actions: Review the Inventory Performance & Aging Report
View summary counts for auction-available items and extended costs
View key inventory data by cost, units, and unique SKUs
Analyze auction-available inventory categories and total auction-available inventory
excluded_adjacent_actions: View and edit current or scheduled auctions
Use search filters by date, product type, or cost range to manage auction listings
Apply bulk actions such as removing checked items or applying profiles
Select products, apply them to events, or schedule timeframes
Compare inventory or site capabilities between Bidz.com and JTVAuctions.com
variant_dimensions: inventory summary metric (cost, units, unique SKUs)
auction-available inventory category (Gemstones, Jewelry, Other, Total Auction Available Inventory)

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is logged into the Auction Admin system with an active authenticated session.
The use case is triggered when the Auctioneer navigates from the Auction Admin Main Menu page to the Inventory Performance & Aging Report page.
The Auctioneer navigates from the Auction Admin Main Menu page to the Inventory Performance & Aging Report page.

The Auctioneer specifies the report criteria by using the 'search for auction items' box with wildcard capability, selecting radio buttons for online status and image/location validity, and choosing a grouping option from the list.

The system displays the report's Results section with standard inventory columns and availability metrics, including Product ID, Active Date, Last Shown Date, Qty on Open Purchase Order, Cost, and inventory quantity/cost totals such as White Total Qty and Red Unsellable Total Cost.

Below the Results section, the system presents a Summary Section that aggregates data based on the Auctioneer's criteria, displaying SKU Count, SKUs Missing Images, SKUs with No/Unsellable Locations, Auction Available Piece Count, Auction Available Extended Cost, Average Unit Cost, and Maximum Unit Cost.

The Auctioneer reviews the Summary Section's counts for auction-available items and extended costs, along with key inventory data by cost, units, and unique SKUs, to analyze inventory availability and aging.

missing_aspects: The specific phrase 'for the selected grouping' is not explicitly supported in the context of the review step; while grouping is a feature (EC-MF-018), the evidence does not explicitly state the review is performed specifically against the selected grouping in the summary view.

claims.content: Diverges from main flow Step 2: The Auctioneer selects the 'Not Grouped' option from the grouping criteria, and the report displays the inventory data without grouping.

Diverges from main flow Step 2: The Auctioneer selects a specific grouping option from the groupings drop-down, such as Setting, Closure, Product Line, Brand, Buyer, Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, Material, Material Purity, Product Group, Inventory Realm, Inventory Aging Bucket, J/G Score, or Ring Size; the report generates corresponding grouped columns.

Diverges from main flow Step 2: The Auctioneer selects the 'Items currently online only' radio button instead of 'All sellable auction inventory' (or vice versa) to narrow the report scope to the chosen online inventory subset.

Diverges from main flow Step 2: The Auctioneer selects radio-button filter options for image presence or location validity to show items with or without images and items with or without a valid (sellable) location.

missing_aspects: The claim mentions a 'None' option which is not explicitly found in the evidence cards (which cite 'Not Grouped').

claims.content: The Inventory Performance & Aging Report is displayed with a Results section containing standard inventory columns and availability metrics, including Product ID, Active Date, Last Shown Date, Qty on Open Purchase Order, Buyer Name, Item Description, Cost, White Total Qty, and Red Unsellable Total Quantity/Cost.

Below the Results section, the Summary Section is displayed and aggregates the report data based on the Auctioneer's chosen criteria, showing SKU Count, SKUs Missing Images, SKUs with No/Unsellable Locations, Auction Available Piece Count, Auction Available Extended Cost, Average Unit Cost, and Maximum Unit Cost.

missing_aspects: Explicit postcondition evidence that the Summary Section displays the auction-available inventory category breakdown (e.g., Gemstones, Jewelry, Other, Total Auction Available Inventory).

citation_audit.description: Latest model-authored candidates after internal semantic grounding verification and DRA; aligned with delivered slots.
